name: Template: Product Roadmap
description: Track features from idea through general availability. Each swimlane represents a product line or area.

swimlanes.name: Mobile App
swimlanes.notes: iOS and Android. Targets field workers and on-the-go board access.

swimlanes.name: API Platform
swimlanes.notes: Public REST API, webhooks, OAuth, and developer experience.

swimlanes.name: Analytics
swimlanes.notes: Board analytics, throughput charts, cycle time, and reporting views.

swimlanes.name: Integrations
swimlanes.notes: Third-party integrations: Slack, GitHub, Jira, Zapier, Linear.

swimlanes.name: Enterprise
swimlanes.notes: Enterprise-tier features: SSO, audit logs, SCIM, multi-tenancy.

cards.title: Offline mode: optimistic updates + sync on reconnect
cards.description:
Allow users to move cards and add comments while offline. Changes are queued locally (IndexedDB) and synced when connectivity resumes.

Conflict resolution: server wins for concurrent edits.

comments.body: Data model designed. Complex feature — will take 2 sprints.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Push notifications for due date approaching
cards.description:
Send a push notification to the card assignee 24h before the due date.

## Acceptance criteria

- Notification delivered within 5 min of the 24h threshold
- Tapping notification opens the card directly
- Users can opt out per-notification type in Settings

checklist.text: Mobile: register for push via FCM/APNs
Deep link: open card from notification

comments.body: Backend task done. Mobile registration in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Drag-to-reorder cards on mobile (touch DnD)
cards.description:
Desktop drag-and-drop uses pointer events. Touch devices need a separate touch sensor with a 250ms long-press to initiate drag.

Use `@dnd-kit/core` `TouchSensor` with appropriate activation constraints.

checklist.text: Test on iOS Safari and Android Chrome

comments.body: TouchSensor configured. iOS Safari scroll lock conflict to resolve.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Deep link: open card from push notification
cards.description:
Push notifications should deep-link directly to the relevant card. URL scheme: `visiban://boards/{board_id}/cards/{card_id}`

Handle both cold-start (app not running) and warm-start (app in background).

checklist.text: Register URL scheme in iOS/Android manifests

comments.body: Cold-start works. Warm-start has a navigation timing issue.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Dark mode support on iOS 17
cards.description:
iOS 17 users reported the app ignores system dark mode preference. The web view background renders white behind the app chrome.

Fix: add `color-scheme: dark` meta tag and ensure all surfaces use the dark token palette.

checklist.text: Audit surface colors in dark mode

comments.body: Released in v1.2.1. No further reports.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: GraphQL endpoint for board data
cards.description:
Some enterprise customers want a GraphQL API to query specific card fields without loading the full board payload.

Use `strawberry-graphql`. Expose: boards, columns, swimlanes, cards (read-only).

comments.body: Backlogged — REST API covers most use cases. Revisit based on demand.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: API v2 planning: deprecate v1 field naming
cards.description:
Several v1 field names are inconsistent (e.g. `last_moved` vs `last_moved_at`). v2 will standardise naming and clean up deprecated fields.

v1 must remain fully functional for at least 2 minor releases after v2 GA.

checklist.text: Audit all v1 field names for inconsistencies
Get team sign-off on v2 schema

cards.title: OpenAPI spec auto-generation from DRF viewsets
cards.description:
Add `drf-spectacular` to auto-generate an OpenAPI 3.1 spec from DRF viewsets and serializers.

Serve the spec at `/api/schema/` and a Swagger UI at `/api/docs/`.

cards.title: Webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff
cards.description:
Currently, failed webhook deliveries are retried immediately 3× with no delay. Replace with exponential backoff: 1min, 5min, 30min, then give up.

Store delivery attempts and status in a `WebhookDelivery` model for debugging.

checklist.text: Implement exponential backoff in Celery task
Add delivery log to developer dashboard

comments.body: Model and backoff logic done. Dashboard view in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Per-token rate limiting on public API
cards.description:
Apply per-API-token rate limits to all public endpoints. Default: 1,000 req/hour. Enterprise: 10,000 req/hour.

Return `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `Retry-After` headers.

comments.body: Middleware done and tested. Docs update in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Stale card heatmap on board view
cards.description:
Overlay a heatmap on the board grid showing which cells have the most stale cards. Cell colour intensity = stale card count.

Toggle: 'Show stale heatmap' button in board toolbar.

checklist.text: Backend: stale count per cell endpoint

cards.title: Cycle time by priority
cards.description: Show average cycle time (first move → Done) broken down by priority. Helps teams see whether high-priority cards are actually moving faster.

checklist.text: Calculate cycle time from CardMovement records
Group by priority in backend endpoint

cards.title: Cumulative flow diagram
cards.description:
Cumulative flow diagram (CFD) shows card counts per column over time. Key insight: widening bands indicate bottlenecks.

Requires daily snapshots of column card counts — add a scheduled task.

checklist.text: CFD endpoint with date range filter

cards.title: Board throughput chart (cards completed per week)
cards.description:
Add a throughput chart to the Analytics tab showing how many cards entered the Done column per week over the last 12 weeks.

Use Recharts. Filter by swimlane and label.

comments.body: Chart renders. Filter wiring is the last piece.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: CSV export: card movement history
cards.description:
Allow board admins to download a CSV of all card movements.

Columns: card_id, title, from_column, to_column, from_swimlane, to_swimlane, moved_by, moved_at.

Scoped to boards the requesting user has access to.

checklist.text: Add download button to Analytics tab

comments.body: Released in v1.2. Used heavily by enterprise customers.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Zapier connector (trigger + action)
cards.description:
Publish a Visiban app on Zapier with:

**Triggers**: Card moved, Card created, Due date approaching

**Actions**: Create card, Move card, Add comment

cards.title: Jira importer: migrate boards and cards
cards.description:
One-time import from Jira Cloud.

Mapping: Jira Project → Board, Jira Issue Status → Column, Jira Epic → Swimlane, Jira Labels → Visiban Labels.

Use Jira REST API with OAuth 2.0.

comments.body: High customer demand — 12 requests this quarter. Prioritising in Q3.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: GitHub: link pull request to card
cards.description:
Allow users to link a GitHub PR to a card. When the PR is merged, move the card to the configured 'merged' column automatically.

Use GitHub webhooks. Store PR link in card metadata.

checklist.text: PR link UI on card detail
Webhook receiver for PR merged event

cards.title: Slack: card move notifications to channel
cards.description:
When a card is moved to a configured column, post a Slack message to a designated channel.

Config: per-board, select trigger column and Slack channel. Use Slack Incoming Webhooks.

checklist.text: Slack Incoming Webhook integration config UI
Backend: send webhook on card move signal

comments.body: Backend wired. Testing with Slack workspace now.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Linear sync (two-way card ↔ issue)
cards.description:
Two-way sync between Visiban cards and Linear issues:

- Linear issue created → Visiban card created
- Visiban card moved → Linear issue status updated

Use Linear webhooks + API.

comments.body: Inbound sync working. Outbound has a race condition — investigating.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: White-label theming (logo + primary colour)
cards.description: Allow enterprise customers to set their own logo and primary brand colour. Config stored per-organisation. Applied at render time via CSS variables.

checklist.text: Add logo_url and primary_color to Organisation
CSS variable injection on page load

comments.body: Lower priority than SSO/SCIM — scheduled for Q4.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: SCIM 2.0 user provisioning
cards.description:
Allow enterprise IdPs to automatically provision and deprovision users via SCIM 2.0.

Endpoints: `/scim/v2/Users` (CRUD) and `/scim/v2/Groups`.

Test with Okta SCIM provisioning.

cards.title: Multi-tenancy: strict org isolation
cards.description:
Ensure data from one organisation is never accessible from another.

Implementation: row-level security via `org_id` FK on all resources. Middleware enforces org scope on every request.

checklist.text: Add org_id FK to Board, User, Label

comments.body: Organisation model done. FK migrations complex — planning zero-downtime approach.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Audit log export (admin panel)
cards.description:
Enterprise admins need to export a complete audit log for compliance. Fields: timestamp, actor, action, resource_type, resource_id, details.

Export formats: JSON and CSV. Date-range filter required.

checklist.text: Wire signals for all auditable events

cards.title: SAML / SSO integration
cards.description:
Support SAML 2.0 SSO for enterprise customers using IdPs such as Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace.

Use `python3-saml`. Configure per-organisation IdP metadata.

Required by 6 enterprise prospects.

checklist.text: Test with Okta and Azure AD
Docs: SSO setup guide for admins

comments.body: Okta and Azure AD both tested. Docs in progress.
comments.author: demo1
